crop.notes: Top of 'The Fistic Folk' column: headlines, the Elliott record and the light-weight item; the rest of the sporting column (base ball, turf, etc.) is not included and does not concern Allen.

ocr.notes: Gist readable; many letter errors and a few garbled phrases (e.g. Kerrigan, Con Orem, 'subsequently backed out').

title.suggested: Tom Allen Named as a Second in Jimmy Elliott's Ring Record

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reviewed Jimmy Elliott's ring record before his match with Johnny Dwyer, noting that Tom Allen was one of Elliott's seconds when he beat Charley Gallagher near Detroit in 1868.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, December 29, 1878, page 6.

facts.fact: Allen was one of Jimmy Elliott's seconds when Elliott beat Charley Gallagher for $600 on Peach Island near Detroit, Elliott being declared the victor at the end of the 23rd round after 1 hour 17 minutes

notes: Current title ('Issues Challenge to Fight') is wrong: the challenge in the article is Elliott's, not Allen's. Article also calls Bill Davis 'Tom Allen's old competitor'.
